name: Cashews
description: Cashews (Anacardium occidentale) are premium botanical seeds highly valued in clinical nutrition for their buttery lipid profile and dense mineral topography. They deliver a bioavailable matrix of monounsaturated fatty acids, structured plant proteomes, and essential cofactors designed to optimize mitochondrial efficiency, stabilize neuromuscular conduction, and support musculoskeletal matrix integrity.
macroIntro: A dense, high-efficiency energy substrate driven by unsaturated lipids and structured proteins, facilitating sustained metabolic output.
microIntro: An elite repository of trace elements, specifically copper and magnesium, which serve as foundational cofactors for systemic vascular and neurological health.

microNutrients.description: Regulator of blood coagulation and calcium-trafficking, preventing arterial calcification by directing minerals to the skeleton.

healthBenefits: Vascular Integrity and Resilience: Superior copper concentration catalyzes elastin and collagen cross-linking, enhancing blood vessel structural elasticity.
Neuromuscular Regulation: Magnesium-dependent modulation of calcium channels in neural tissues attenuates stress responses and supports restorative sleep cycles.
Lipid Homeostasis: Oleic acid fractions assist in the stabilization of LDL/HDL ratios, fostering optimal cardiovascular risk markers.
Bone Matrix Optimization: Synergy between Phosphorus, Manganese, and Vitamin K facilitates efficient skeletal mineral deposition and reduces fracture vulnerability.
precautionsIntro: Given their caloric density and biochemical inhibitors, prudent consumption is advised:
precautions: Caloric Density: Extreme energy concentration necessitates intentional portion tracking to avoid undesirable energy surpluses in restricted metabolic states.
Antinutrient Profile: The presence of phytates and oxalates may inhibit trace mineral bioavailability; individuals with calcium-oxalate urolithiasis should exercise caution.
Processing Safety: Raw seeds contain anacardic acid; rigorous commercial roasting/steaming is mandatory to neutralize toxic shell residues before consumption.
